      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly alters P2P message deserialization to reject empty transactions and silently ignore malformed peer messages.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "The PR hardens P2P message deserialization against memory-expansion DoS attacks. As noted in commit e1cbb976d2, immediately rejecting empty transactions during P2P deserialization caps block deserialization memory expansion from ~17 bytes per byte received to ~6 bytes per byte."
    },

      "name": "rpc",

    },

      "band": "Unranked",

    },

    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Reworks core serialization and memory representation primitives in CScriptWitness and CTxIn.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Storing witness stacks in serialized form fixes a severe memory expansion and CPU resource exhaustion issue in core serialization primitives. PR benchmarks show worst-case block deserialization memory drops from 112 MB to 4.0 MB and execution time drops from over 300 ms to under 20 ms."
    }
